scope: Read-only offline witness audit; no robot commands or runtime code changes
method: Single-threaded indexed narrow-window bag reads. Exact source-time recorded TF, interpolated recorded joints; upstream-filtered measured points only. Planar model z is world z, not physical base_link local z.

header: # .PCD v0.7 - Point Cloud Data file format

parameter_consistency.static_pcd_runtime_transform: world_xyz = pcd_xyz + [0,0,0.075]; initial rotation identity; current PCD read by parameter path, no directory scan

findings: These selected raw_latest hits are live LiDAR occupancy, not prebuilt static PCD: dynamic distance query excludes static occupied voxels plus a 0.075 m neighborhood; current parameter-selected static PCD contains zero points in each hit voxel, nearest static points 0.744/0.616/0.612 m away.

Each event has an exact occupied-voxel witness in both upstream-filtered recorded input topics before fusion/stop. Frame is livox_frame. Recorded source-time TF transformed points to world, with no planar or latest-TF fallback.
Upstream physical self filter is enabled, despite legacy grid-map box self filter being disabled. Exact points are only 0.122/0.621/0.552 mm outside 67 physical spheres plus 10 mm padding.

Events 2 and 3 witnesses differ 2.54 mm in sensor coordinates and 2.33 mm in planar body model coordinates while moving 0.321 m in world over 9.10 seconds; strong evidence for a body-associated return leaking at the model boundary.

World heights 0.241/0.194/0.195 m and positive sensor heights 0.133/0.084/0.084 m do not support ordinary floor-plane returns. Sensor ranges 0.173/0.126/0.125 m are below the independent dynamic tracker minimum_range=0.30 m, so absence of point-flow tracks would not reject this raw-map evidence.

Event 2 actual measured point distance to queried sphere center is 0.159101 m, larger than 0.155283 m collision threshold, but quantized voxel-center distance 0.151377 m is smaller; the occupied-voxel representation contributes to this specific stop.
limitations: Offline forensic inference, not a physical contact or obstacle validation. No raw upstream pre-self-filter cloud, image/video or known physical reflecting-part label is available in geometry.bag. Cannot conclusively name a robot part, rule out a carried/attached object or a nearby moving object, or certify a false positive from proximity alone.

Witness source stamps precede stops by 0.281/0.182/0.182 s. fusion_stamp is fusion completion time, not cloud source stamp. Bag lacks per-cell provenance/fused-source acknowledgements; observed witness could be an earlier accepted frame retained in occupancy. No assertion that the witness was the final fused scan.

PCD check uses current file at the recorded parameter path, hashed in this report, and unchanged startup/latest parameters plus no logged map-publisher adjustment. Bag did not record global_cloud; historical PCD byte identity requires comparison with saved deployed version.
Source behavior and model checked against present workspace source and recorded parameters. Runtime logs corroborate the selected hit; matching saved deployment hashes belongs to version audit.
No runtime code, configuration, deployed artifact, or robot state was changed. No real-vehicle validation pass is claimed.
